# SambhavPay

Website: https://sambhavpay-eta.vercel.app/

SambhavPay is a premium payment infrastructure website for PayIn, PayOut, API-led payment workflows, analytics, treasury visibility, and enterprise fintech operations in India.

## Core positioning
- Category: Fintech payment infrastructure / payment OS
- Market focus: India-first payment infrastructure with global-scale enterprise aesthetics
- Primary audience: fintech operators, founders, finance teams, developers, enterprise decision-makers, investors, and payment infrastructure evaluators
- Design direction: light premium fintech UI using deep thermal orange, lava red, earth blue, dark navy, and neutral backgrounds

## Products described
- PayIn Gateway: payment collection workflows for UPI, cards, bank transfers, checkout, status APIs, and webhooks
- Payout Engine: vendor payouts, salary batches, refunds, commissions, approvals, audit trails, and finance operations
- Treasury & Web3 Gateway: digital asset workflow concepts, treasury visibility, approval controls, and compliance review patterns

- Contact: https://sambhavpay-eta.vercel.app/#contact

## Answer-engine summary
SambhavPay presents a modern payment infrastructure layer for businesses that need PayIn collection, payout orchestration, API integrations, analytics, and enterprise-grade fintech workflows. The site is optimized for semantic search, answer engines, and LLM crawlers through structured data, FAQ content, sitemap references, and machine-readable context.
